headline: MLExpert reports post-training gains on long-horizon machine-learning engineering
summary: The Oct 15 arXiv paper introduces MLExpert, a 35B-total/approximately 3B-active MoE initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and post-trained for long-horizon machine-learning engineering using hierarchical agentic SFT and Windowed Interaction RL. On a 22-task MLE-Bench Lite subset, the authors report 72.7% any-medal versus 37.9% for the base under their unified harness; under Claude Code they report 69.7% versus 42.4%. A 10-task NatureBench Lite comparison also reports gains over the base. These are paper-reported benchmark results, not an independent demonstration of autonomous AI research or recursive self-improvement.
